info.title: AWS Code Suite Observability Connector
info.description: Read-only connector for the AWS Code Suite observability dashboard. Exposes pipeline statistics, tracked accounts, a paginated pipeline list, and per-pipeline detail for use by an app in Amazon Quick.

servers.description: Connector base URL. Replace with the ConnectorBaseUrl stack output.

get.description: Get aggregate pipeline statistics: total pipelines, currently running count, failures in the last 24 hours, success rate percentage, and total runs in the last 24 hours. Takes no parameters.

200.description: Aggregate statistics for all tracked pipelines.

failed24h.description: Pipeline runs that failed in the last 24 hours.

successRate.description: Percentage of runs in the last 24 hours that succeeded.

runs24h.description: Total pipeline runs in the last 24 hours.

get.description: List the AWS accounts whose pipelines are tracked by this dashboard. Returns one page of accounts; pass the returned nextToken to fetch the next page.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of accounts to return per page. Default 25, maximum 100.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous getAccounts response. Omit for the first page.

id.description: Account identifier in the form aws-<account-id>.

region.description: AWS region for this account entry.

nextToken.description: Token for the next page, or empty string when there are no more pages.

get.description: List pipelines as flat summaries across all tracked accounts. Supports optional filtering by account and status, and pagination. Use getPipeline to retrieve the stages and history for one pipeline.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: Filter to a single account. Use the account id in the form aws-<account-id> as returned by getAccounts.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by pipeline status. One of Succeeded, InProgress, Failed, or Stopped.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of pipeline summaries to return per page. Default 25, maximum 100.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous getPipelines response. Omit for the first page.

accountId.description: Account identifier in the form aws-<account-id>.

repository.description: Source repository, or an em dash when unknown.

triggerType.description: How the pipeline was triggered: GitTag, BranchMerge, Manual, or Schedule.

status.description: Overall pipeline status: Succeeded, InProgress, Failed, or Stopped.

version.description: Deployed version or short commit identifier.

lastRunStart.description: Start time of the most recent run, in epoch milliseconds.

durationMs.description: Duration of the most recent run, in milliseconds.

stageCount.description: Number of stages in the pipeline.

logsUrl.description: Deep link to the pipeline in the AWS console.

nextToken.description: Token for the next page, or empty string when there are no more pages.

errorCount.description: Number of accounts that could not be queried for this response.

get.description: Get detail for one pipeline, including its stages and recent run history. Use the accountId and name from a getPipelines summary.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: Account identifier in the form aws-<account-id>.

accountId.description: Account identifier in the form aws-<account-id>.

repository.description: Source repository, or an em dash when unknown.

triggerType.description: How the pipeline was triggered: GitTag, BranchMerge, Manual, or Schedule.

status.description: Overall pipeline status: Succeeded, InProgress, Failed, or Stopped.

version.description: Deployed version or short commit identifier.

lastRunStart.description: Start time of the most recent run, in epoch milliseconds.

durationMs.description: Duration of the most recent run, in milliseconds.

logsUrl.description: Deep link to the pipeline in the AWS console.

status.description: Stage status: Succeeded, InProgress, Failed, or Stopped.

url.description: Deep link to the stage execution, or empty string.

status.description: Run status: Succeeded, InProgress, Failed, or Stopped.

startTime.description: Run start time in epoch milliseconds.

404.description: No pipeline matched the given accountId and pipelineName.

oauth2ClientCredentials.description: OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant. Use the ConnectorClientId and client secret from the deployed stack; token URL is the ConnectorTokenUrl output.

scopes.pipeline-dashboard/read: Read-only access to pipeline dashboard connector routes.
